# Sessions of the Federal Assembly, during which bot-chparl.yml runs.
#
# One session per line: first day, last day (both inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD,
# Swiss local date), then an optional label. Scheduled runs on any other day
# stop at the gate job; a manual run from the Actions tab always goes ahead.
#
# When the last session here has ended, every scheduled run fails until the
# next ones are added.
